claims.text: Persistent diabetic macular edema: intraocular dexamethasone implant or intravitreal triamcinolone; a fluocinolone implant
claims.quote: An intraocular dexamethasone implant and intravitreal triamcinolone can treat eyes with persistent macular edema; an intraocular fluocinolone implant is also available in some countries.

claims.text: Fluocinolone implant (Iluvien): FDA-labeled for DME after a corticosteroid course w.o a significant IOP rise
claims.quote: ILUVIEN is a corticosteroid indicated for: the treatment of diabetic macular edema (DME) in patients who have been previously treated with a course of corticosteroids and did not have a clinically significant rise in intraocular pressure.
